# dispatch_onto behavior in xpcom/rust/moz_task/src/dispatcher.rs

Builds a default-priority, default-option one-shot callback and immediately calls RunnableBuilder::dispatch(target).

## State read

- name, callback, target

## State changed

- new builder/runnable through callee

## Calls and triggers

- RunnableBuilder::new at dispatcher.rs:55-62 then dispatch(target)

## Result and consumers

Returns the callee dispatch Result; success is queue acceptance, not callback completion.

## Errors

Propagates dispatch failure; local helper also propagates current-thread lookup failure.

## Async completion

Queues callback for later execution; no awaitable result.

## Ownership and cleanup

Moves callback into builder and then native runnable; local helper allows non-Send, other helpers require Send.

pub fn dispatch_onto<F>(
    name: &'static str,
    target: &nsIEventTarget,
    function: F,
) -> Result<(), nsresult>
where
    F: FnOnce() + Send + 'static,
{
    RunnableBuilder::new(name, function).dispatch(target)
}
